## What changed

- A draft decision no longer puts the summary behind. Adding a draft,
  editing it while it stays a draft, or deleting it is no change for the
  summary's freshness check, so `kmctl new decision` needs no
  `kmctl summary ack`. Accepting the draft still counts, so the summary is
  checked once the choice is settled. A decision changed back from stable
  to draft also counts (ADR 0058, #76).
- When `kmctl check` or `kmctl review due` fails in the CI action, the job
  log now ends with an `::error` line. It names the failed command and
  links the run's summary page, where the reasons are. Before, the log said
  only "Process completed with exit code 1" (#77).
- ADR 0057 is accepted: the audit will also run on a pull request from the
  same repository and post one comment on it. This release adds only the
  decision record. The audit itself is not built yet (#71).

## Before you upgrade

Nothing to do. An ack that a branch made only for a new draft does no harm.

## Other changes

- The knowledge rules and the CI action how-to say that a draft does not
  put the summary behind and an accept does. The okf-bundle hash in
  `OLD_RULES` moved, and its comment names ADR 0058 (#76).

## Install

```sh
uv tool install git+https://github.com/JasperHG90/kmctl@v0.18.0#subdirectory=packages/kmctl
```

In a workflow:

```yaml
- uses: JasperHG90/kmctl@v0.18.0
```

**Full diff**: https://github.com/JasperHG90/kmctl/compare/v0.17.1...v0.18.0
